scope: Charge-resolved no-shakeoff EC event maps, prescribed frozen-hazard kernel, nine-state nuclear generator and actual-donor conditional families with a 22-population bookkeeping adapter.
review_method: Read code, tests, raw EC_RESULTS.json and EC_TEST_LOG.txt; inspect numerical records and compare donor identity, original bridge assignments and packaging authorization. No suite rerun, new experiment or implementation edit.
implementation_checks: Bound q0..3 deposits into Li_q; continuum q1..4 deposits into Li_(q-1). Bare bound and neutral continuum hazards/counts raise explicit forbidden-channel errors.

Parent budget and continuum electron budget are checked before updates. Explicit delta_free,delta_bound and nuclear/ionic-charge rewards preserve donor-scale signals independently of rounded order-one backgrounds.

Tiny allowed electron-budget residuals remain raw and are reported without clipping, as prescribed by the frozen engineering tolerance. This is not a claim that negative physical inventories are admissible.
Frozen exponential competition branches correctly and zero hazards are exact. Continuum density conversion is explicitly prescribed rather than dynamically closed.
Nine-state generator has nonnegative off-diagonals and zero column sums within roundoff. Electron ledgers remain outside the one-particle generator.

Uniformization splits nu*dt to<=10 and uses compensated Poisson accumulation. Its descending-ratio geometric bound on omitted positive terms and summed split bound are valid; finite truncation is disclosed.

All 8 channels are checked at unit and donor scale, with competition, zero hazard, electron-budget/forbidden-channel rejections, split uniformization and independent SciPy matrix exponential references.

Actual donor is read by frozen SHA and source commit. All original excluded nuclides are preserved except Be7 moved once into auxiliary bins. Existing H/D/T/He/Li charge assignments match CONTRACT_BRIDGE.md and remain conditional.
22-population adapter is distinct from the 9-population evolving nuclear subsystem and claims no native17 change. Original baryon normalization defect remains unrepaired.
106.4-day clock applies only to prepared Be3 with fixed statistical hyperfine populations and no charge exchange or continuum capture. Exposure families do not infer a cosmological epoch.
Actual heat is null NEEDS_ENERGY_PARTITION. Synthetic energy identity is explicitly nonphysical input; no neutrino or gamma energy is silently deposited as heat.
claim_ceiling: Locally validated bounded conditional kernel and donor bookkeeping only.
Prescribed hazards are not a dynamically closed plasma or a full recombination/EC history.
No actual charge-specific rate inference beyond the explicitly conditional approximate Be3 clock.
No daughter electronic-state/shakeoff prediction, thermal history, native17 implementation or physical checkpoint advancement.
next_action: Publish scoped EC code, exact-donor conditional output and preserved raw validation with unresolved physical-input boundary.
